paragraphs: Backend engineer based in India. I build and operate systems that hold up under pressure: APIs, event pipelines, and applied AI tooling, with a bias toward correctness, observability, and clean architecture.
features: Focus: backend systems and applied AI / agentic pipelines.
Principle: deterministic code where it matters, model driven where it helps.
Apex Ledger: secure peer to peer payment wallet (FastAPI) with real time transfers, JWT auth, Redis caching with circuit breaker fallback, idempotency keys, Docker, and CI.
Gen Argus: real time telemetry pipeline (Flask, Kafka, Postgres) with a validated ingestion API, batched Postgres consumer, and live Chart.js dashboard. Live demo.
AtlasOPS: precision job matching pipeline (Python) using deterministic hard filters and an LLM evaluator with an adversarial verifier, ranked and explainable end to end.
